assumptions.name: fixed_PB_source
assumptions.description: Every physical wave uses fixed0123 source order; useful ECC pages are its subsequence. No source permutation or cache-read mux.

assumptions.name: pre_ECC_drop
assumptions.description: Dummy pages are physically read, discarded from read latches at array-ready, and never copied to cache or decoded. Existing cached pages remain reserved through their ECC end. Native discard/gating support is unverified.

assumptions.name: skip_WL_CR
assumptions.description: All waves stay in a single block with no idle interval; selected WL may change.

assumptions.name: IPR
assumptions.description: Phase and group split controls use independent plane WLs. Group plain and group whole-dummy controls read the same WL on all four planes and require no IPR.

assumptions.name: whole_owner_dot
assumptions.description: Consume all6 phase or12 group expert pages before another expert; shared pages follow. Dummy reads do not update the dot accumulator or reset its row phase. Existing common-input owner/scatter behavior is inherited; no new PE selector is added.

assumptions.name: PB_model
assumptions.description: One read and one cache weight page per plane, two other latches input; whole-page per-plane copy; cache reserved to ECC completion; evaluation overwrite starts6040ns after CR start; copy overlaps recycle.

assumptions.name: timing
assumptions.description: Cold first-ready28000ns, continuous CR9700ns, copy500ns primary or100ns sensitivity, chip-shared ECC6.4GB/s. First-ready28us/final-discharge0 is conservative accounting, not measured first-page timing.

assumptions.name: all_dummy_input_domain
assumptions.description: Sealed v1 requires a useful page in every wave. The restricted full-plane reference explicitly admits all-dummy waves and preserves the same resources.432 nonempty cases bridge exactly; separate independent audit is requested.

assumptions.name: format_and_capacity
assumptions.description: W8_A8,1536-byte GU rows, exact source coefficients,58 declared additional fullGU copies. GU186MiB plus tripleprivateDown144MiB plus sharedDown1.5MiB equals331.5MiB within384MiB. No extra contexts,FIFO or undeclared weight copies.

assumptions.name: attribution
assumptions.description: 58 dual copies is minimal only within two-full-copy/capacity3 contract. Ordinary g8 wholeGU replicas are an equal-byte strong control. No phase-specific or new CBC algorithm claim.
